headquarters.rule: Roll a d10 when entering a new Settlement to find the controlling faction. If a faction already has a Settlement, reroll until all 5 factions have one. You can't enter a Settlement with negative Favor with the ruling faction. Pay off bounty: 75 Serum per negative point.

facilities.hangar: Hull fully restored on entering a Settlement. Buy pre-built ships, ship modules, or sell modules for half their Scrap cost. Refuel: 3 Serum per unit of Fuel.
facilities.wiredoc: Health fully restored on entering a Settlement. Install/purchase cybertech, or sell cybertech for half its original cost.
facilities.tradingHub: Sell items/equipment for their marked cost (rounding up). Buy from the Trade Post table. Some items are exclusive to specific faction Settlements.

activities.name: Test Flight
activities.effect: Speed Race - ROLL GRACE: if you succeed, your ship moves 1 extra tile for the next 2 battles. Combat Drill - if you succeed, +1 Action Die per turn during your next space battle.

activities.name: Cybersphere
activities.effect: Log into a sector of the Cybersphere. Circuit of 10 diamond tiles. Reach Matrix Nodes, collect rewards, escape through a different Access Port before memory runs out. 12 moves.

activities.name: Scrapyard
activities.effect: Craft any weapon, Mod, Armor, Drone, or Hack item by spending Scraps equal to its Serum cost. First craft gives 1 EXP. Dismantle items for Scraps equal to half the Serum cost (rounding up).

activities.name: Combat Sim
activities.effect: Simulate a fight with an enemy of your choice. Win: gain EXP based on difficulty and +2 VIT until your next fight with that enemy. No loot. Items consumed. Can't die. Reset HP & Energy after.

activities.name: Home Pods
activities.effect: Meet NPCs via the NPC Generator. Hire Crewmembers for your starship.

cybersphere.networkMap: Roll a d8 to determine the network layout (8 maps, 10-tile diamond grids). Move one tile at a time to diagonally adjacent tiles. Defeat in combat: logged out, lose 10 Hyperdrive instead of dying.
cybersphere.memoryClockRule: 12 moves to explore. Mark 1 cell every time you move to a new tile or when {CLOCK +1}. When limit reached, suffer an Abyssal Scar.

sidequests.rule: Sidequests grant +1 Favor with the controlling faction. Available if you have between 0 and 3 Favor with the ruling faction and no previous uncompleted sidequests.
warg: Defeat an ISF A-1 Voyager approaching the Settlement, 1 tile north.
Recapture a WARG outpost 2 tiles south, recently taken by an Android Synth.
Travel to the nearest satellite and ambush a patrol of 2 ISF Soldiers.
Provide combat support by defeating a Mercenary on the nearest planet.
Craft 5 Frog Grenades at the Scrapyard. You can keep them after the sidequest.
Train your combat abilities by defeating an ISF Sentinel in the Combat Sim.
isf: Gain a Terraform Seed and plant it on the nearest planet.
Defeat 2 Rebel Fighters hiding on the nearest satellite.
Deliver a cargo container to an ISF Checkpoint, 3 tiles southeast.
Help repair the Settlement's broken water chip by providing 100 Scraps.
Complete a successful Speed Race at the Settlement's Test Flight facility.
Defeat 2 Smuggler Speeders, 1 tile north and 1 tile south, respectively.
medusa: Steal a NGHTMR Key from an ISF Beluga Transporter, 2 tiles northeast.
Destroy a net jammer located 4 tiles southeast, protected by an Automaton Bot.
Defeat 2 Android Synths who have destroyed an antenna, 1 tile southwest.
Log in, reach a Matrix Node, and log off the Cybersphere in 5 moves or less.
Successfully reach 2 Matrix Nodes in the same run while surfing the Cybersphere.
Defeat any 2 enemies while inside the Cybersphere.
corsair: Steal a Tesseract guarded by a Cyborg on the nearest satellite.
Gain a random melee mod by defeating a WARG Vector-7 Montis, 1 tile south.
Attack an ISF Beluga Transporter 2 tiles north and steal 60 Serum from it.
Gain a Contraband Package and smuggle it into another faction's Settlement.
Travel to a Pirate Hideout at the nearest unexplored Outer Ring tile.
Complete a successful Combat Drill at the Settlement's Test Flight facility.
synthArch: Retrieve a Tesseract from a Helios Farm and offer it to the Settlement's prophet.
Destroy a spy drone 1 tile north, defended by a Medusa Orion Moth.
Defeat 2 Looters that have raided a synth factory on the nearest planet.
Gain 60 Scraps by dismantling items and equipment, and offer them to the Arch.

Gain 3 EXP by crafting 3 items at the Scrapyard for the first time.
